title: A concrete output target
hook: Two stated cases: explore the rate required to reach a stated goal.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the rate required to reach a stated goal affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Hours, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the rate required to reach a stated goal in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy worker stops exactly at income 100 and earns 10 per hour. After how many hours do they stop?
